InspectionReport.title: InspectionReport
InspectionReport.description: An IQAF-005 Store Inspection Checklist report supporting incremental cloud autosave, version tracking, collaborator email sharing, and shareable links.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated inspector who owns this report.

ownerName.description: Display name of the report owner shown to collaborators.

reportSequence.description: Auto-incremented per-branch, per-year report sequence number (1..99999) used in INSPLND-BRANCH-YY-NNN.

timeOfInspection.description: Inspection start time in HH:MM format.

timeOfInspectionEnded.description: Optional time when the inspection ended in HH:MM format.

responses.description: Map of checklist item number strings ('1'-'70') to compliance status, deviation, and corrective action.

signOffs.description: Map of performedBy, acknowledgedBy, notedBy, reviewedBy, and approvedBy sign-off entries including printedName, date, and signatureDataUrl.

stats.description: Denormalized summary counts (answered, yes, no, na, photoCount) for fast report listing.

photoIds.description: Bounded list (max 250) of photo document IDs in the photos subcollection so shared collaborators can fetch photos via Master Gate without list queries.

sharedWithEmails.description: Bounded list (max 25) of lowercase Google account emails granted viewer or editor access.

editorEmails.description: Bounded list (max 25) of lowercase Google account emails granted collaborative edit access.

activeShareLinkId.description: Optional active share link ID from /shareLinks/{shareId}, or empty/null when disabled.

activeShareRole.description: Role granted to verified users who claim activeShareLinkId.

lastClaimedShareLinkId.description: Token echoed during share-link claim to prove knowledge of activeShareLinkId.

syncVersion.description: Monotonically increasing save revision counter (1..1000000) for conflict detection.

lastEditedByUid.description: UID of the user who performed the most recent save.

lastEditedByName.description: Display name of the user who performed the most recent save.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was last saved.

InspectionPhoto.title: InspectionPhoto
InspectionPhoto.description: A compressed photo proof document stored in a report's photos subcollection so reports can hold many photos online without exceeding document size limits.

ownerId.description: UID of the parent report owner.

uploadedByUid.description: UID of the authenticated user (owner or editor) who uploaded this photo.

deviation.description: Deviation or findings recorded for the item.

caption.description: User caption describing the photo proof.

storeLocation.description: Store location copied from parent report for display.

inspectionDate.description: Inspection date copied from parent report.

dataUrl.description: Compressed JPEG base64 data URL (supports HD uploads strictly bounded <= 920 KB within the 1 MiB document cap).

capturedAt.description: ISO timestamp when photo was captured or attached.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when photo record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when photo record was last updated.

ShareLink.title: ShareLink
ShareLink.description: An unguessable capability link created by a report owner to grant verified signed-in recipients viewer or editor access without exposing collaborator emails.

ownerId.description: UID of the report owner who created the share link.

ownerName.description: Display name of the report owner.

documentationNo.description: Form documentation number for link preview.

reportSequence.description: Optional per-branch, per-year report sequence number (1..99999) for link preview.

role.description: Access level granted when a verified user claims this link.

active.description: Whether this share link is currently active (false = revoked).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the share link was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the share link was last updated.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Stores IQAF-005 Store Inspection Checklist reports with incremental sync versioning and collaborator sharing.

/reports/{reportId}/photos/{photoId}.description: Stores individual compressed photo proof documents belonging to a parent inspection report.

/shareLinks/{shareId}.description: Stores revocable shareable link tokens granting verified users viewer or editor access to an inspection report.
